title: Symmetry-Projected Weakly Compatible Multiparameter Quantum Sensing
summary: Achieving joint quantum-enhanced precision in multiparameter sensing requires both high sensitivity and measurement compatibility. These two aspects are characterized by the quantum Fisher information matrix (QFIM) and the Uhlmann curvature matrix (UCM), respectively, with weak compatibility corresponding to the vanishing of the relevant UCM elements. Here, we develop a symmetry-projection framework that classifies phase generators into subspace-preserving and subspace-changing sectors.
